summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the comparative cloud service models prototype (Hybrid Offline-First vs Pure SaaS POS) for Alinase Nyirenda's University of Zambia MA research study (UNZA NASREC: 2026-JAN: 030). Includes full-stack Express cloud persistence, client-side offline transactional queue, real-time tracking, authentication, research data visualization dashboard, and CSV export.
